output_list.criticism: In _finish(), function findWinner(uint value) is used to find the winner based on the hash value. However, the hash value (curhash) is based on block timestamp, block coinbase, block difficulty and curhash itself, which is predictable. If the attacker tries to make the guesses array full and call _finish() frequently, he can predict the winner and make the money from the lottery. The better way is to use a truly random number generation to choose the winner.
